headline: Both accounts authorized; no broker repair needed
summary: At 01:04 Eastern on October 19, both accounts completed successful prompted keepalives. Independent metadata-only checks then succeeded for both accounts. The broker and watchdog are healthy; no implementation change or restart is warranted.
cause: Authorization: the alert snapshot captured the previous successful round before the prompted calls finished at 01:04:10 and 01:04:14 Eastern. Those calls returned exit 0 in 11.18 and 3.31 seconds. The preceding hour of sanitized keepalive events contains successful calls and no failure or lock transition. The exact authorization-renewal trigger is unproven. Parser/watchdog: current log parsing and persisted state both report unlocked, the heartbeat advances, no fault episode is active, and deployed hashes/build stamp/signature match. The bounded log tail retains an older last-lock timestamp than the running state; preserving the newer known lock is expected rotation handling. authorization_or_unknown alone is not failure evidence.
resolution: No candidate patch, live implementation change, installation, restart or agent-requested auth wake was needed. Broker PID/session 1213, PTY /dev/ttys000 and keepalive PID 1214 were preserved. Only sanitized incident evidence and a README incident note were added. The first-click gate remains false; policy permits a verified no-change settlement without a click.
verification: 44 focused Python tests passed across broker transport, keepalive/parser, recovery gating, activation and agent guidance. All three Node test files for dispatch, settlement and deferred archive exited successfully. Deployed source hashes, running keepalive hash, build stamp and bundle signature verified. Both wrapper vault-list calls returned exit 0 in 1.020 and 0.920 seconds with stdout/stderr discarded. Heartbeat advanced from 01:04:34 to 01:04:54 Eastern with unchanged identities. Chat title, dotfiles cwd, Pinned section and strongest advertised desktop model gpt-6-astra/high were read back. See artifacts/*.json and the reproducible read-only verify.py.
activation: The existing broker and keepalive remain running. Nothing is staged; no service load or activation command is required.
limitations: Exact authorization-renewal cause and physical consent interaction were not established. No credential content was read and no UI or physical notification-click test was performed. Deferred archive is verified only by its later private receipt; scheduling does not prove archival.
docs: Reviewed README.md, agent-contract.md and autofixes/AGENTS.md. Updated src/onepassword/README.md with this incident and the stale successful snapshot versus completed prompted-call distinction. The shared contract and autofix policy remain accurate and unchanged; no guidance synchronization was required.
